title: The Weather of Milton Flats
author: Jude Sandoval
blurb: Beatrix Nystrom, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent fifteen years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
